learnings.question: According to the Quran in Surah Ar-Ra’d (13:11), under what circumstance will Allah change the condition of a people?
options: When they withdraw entirely from public life
Until they change what is in themselves
Only after they face a severe disaster
Once they completely eliminate all worldly desires
learnings.learning: Surah Ar-Ra’d (13:11) establishes the principle of personal responsibility, stating that Allah does not change the condition of a people until they take the initiative to change what is within themselves.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: Which three-part strategy is recommended to overcome natural forgetfulness and ensure personal insights remain useful rather than lost?
options: Writing ideas down, building a recall system, and sharing the knowledge publicly
Relying on mental repetition, avoiding digital note-taking, and keeping lessons private
Limiting written records, using passive review techniques, and memorizing core principles
Hoarding notes in private static files, re-reading them weekly, and minimizing external sharing
learnings.learning: To combat natural forgetfulness and avoid treating the brain like a filing cabinet, one should write down insights, establish an active system to trigger recall, and share that knowledge publicly.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: Which Scrum artifact is specifically designed to visualize the progress of a Sprint and display the remaining work?
learnings.learning: In Scrum, the Burndown Chart is the artifact that visualizes the progress of a Sprint by showing the remaining work and tracking whether the team is on schedule.

learnings.question: What is the primary motivation for implementing Power Management States in PCIe devices?
options: To ensure efficient energy use, extend device longevity, and save power based on activity while remaining responsive
To eliminate the need for physical hardware cooling components in peripheral devices
To permanently limit device transmission bandwidth to prevent electromagnetic interference
To convert high-speed serial data transmission into parallel bus communication
learnings.learning: PCIe Power Management States are implemented to achieve efficient energy consumption, extend device longevity, and save energy based on device activity while maintaining necessary responsiveness.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe
